Card Q&A.q: I don’t have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] in its traits in play. Can I delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less and [X Antibody] in its traits with this card's effect?

I have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] in its traits in play. Can I delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less and [X Antibody] in its traits with this card's effect?

Effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less. If you have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X-Antibody] in its traits in play, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon without [X-Antibody] in its traits instead.
